title: Constructible sheaves over a finite ring have etale origin
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $B$ a finite commutative ring. For the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] of the small pro-etale and etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{Et}}$, and the constructibility notions [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], pullback $\nu_T^*$ induces an equivalence between constructible sheaves of $B$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ and intrinsically constructible sheaves of $B$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ (locally constant with finite module stalks on a finite partition by locally closed constructible subschemes).

source.place: Tag 09AK, lemma-compare-constructible; global finite-stratification refinement using restriction compatibility and finite locally constant comparison (lemma-compare-locally-constant, Tag 099Y). No qcqs assumption on T is imposed.

proof.text: Restrict intrinsic modules to their constant scalars using [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-encoding]. Identify the intrinsic and fixed-module pro-etale constructibility predicates by [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-constructibility], and identify the etale constructibility predicates by lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison. The original positive global finite partitions and canonical tensor pullbacks are retained.

Compose etale comparison pullback with the inverse encoding equivalence and restrict to the constructible full subcategories. The fixed-module constructible-origin theorem supplies essential surjectivity. Full faithfulness of comparison pullback, from its invertible unit, and of the encoding equivalence supplies full faithfulness. Hence this restricted functor is an equivalence.

The inverse encoding counit gives the natural additive comparison. Each component of this counit is a linear isomorphism over ULift B. Its linearity says exactly that constant scalar multiplication is multiplication by the image of b under the canonical constant-section map. This proves the precise final clause, not merely an abstract equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AK and 099Y; reuse the existing fixed-module constructible-origin theorem after explicit constant-scalar encoding, pullback, and constructibility identifications (U1, 2026-10-18).
